Perrin often mentions a blacksmith's puzzle when trying to figure out how to rescue Faile from the Shaido, such as in the Prologue of KoD, and also in the Crossroads of Twilight. Is this the same thing as a tavern puzzle? Snadles 03:46, January 10, 2011 (UTC)
